objective: Implement governed IBM Watson TTS, Audexum TTS and Freesound audio-asset enrichment behind existing VoiceFabric/external-provider boundaries.

rulesConsidered: External providers are replaceable resources, not authorities.
VoiceFabric remains the authoritative physical audio verification pipeline.
Provider-reported duration is never accepted as physical truth.
Freesound license and generative-AI preference metadata must remain addressable.
Speak AI is not misrepresented as a TTS provider without an endpoint contract.

notes: IBM credentials are consumed only at runtime; instance URL is configured separately.
Freesound API tokens are server-side and never emitted to result objects.

changes: Added IBM Watson Text to Speech engine to VoiceFabric.
Added Audexum TTS engine to VoiceFabric.
Added provider-neutral Freesound audio-asset search contract and adapter.
Added deterministic authentication, request-shape, normalization and malformed-response tests.
Added audio provider environment configuration and .okf documentation.
verificationPlan: Require CI and Team Change Gate to pass before merge.
Keep IBM/Audexum/Freesound live qualification separate from deterministic tests.
Use the existing VoiceFabric physical ffprobe + SHA verification path for live audio proofs.
notes: This PR does not claim live provider qualification.
Speak AI remains catalogued for media/transcription/analysis only.
The existing Edge/Gemini/ElevenLabs routing model remains unchanged unless a caller explicitly selects the new engines.
